title: Single hieratic sign, Leiden, Rijksmuseum van Oudheden, AMS 26 b vso (AKU HT 8575)

object.name: Leiden, Rijksmuseum van Oudheden, AMS 26 b vso
object.content: Brief (an einen Lebenden) (Brief des Keny-Imen an Hui)

source.attribution: Georg Möller, Hieratische Paläographie, retro-digitised by AKU-PAL (Akademie der Wissenschaften und der Literatur Mainz), AKU Hieratogramm 8575

notes: AKU-PAL Hieratogramm (HT) 8575; AKU grapheme Q0160 (AKU GR 515). Gold = the grapheme's MdC code(s) as given by AKU-PAL: Q6 (std). Möller numbers listed by AKU-PAL for this grapheme: 372, 372 (v4p13). Source publication of this facsimile: Möller 1927b. Occurrence: line 3; find place Sakkara; writing direction "Zeilen, linksläufig prograd"; sign size 7.9 x 9.6 mm (h x w). AKU dating: "Neues Reich, 19. Dynastie, Ramses II.". Facsimile type: Retro-Digitalisat (Publikation), by Georg Möller. Source scan (WEBP) converted to PNG at native resolution, flattened onto white, white margin added.
